name: Novotel Visakhapatnam Varun Beach
location: Beach Road, Maharani Peta, Visakhapatnam — the only ocean-facing 5-star on the seafront
why_special: Vizag's headline business-and-leisure hotel — 225 ocean-facing rooms on Beach Road, part of a complex with an INOX multiplex, mall and rooftop lounge. The pick if you want the city's biggest convention hotel with the sea directly outside the window, walkable to RK Beach and the Submarine Museum.

name: The Park Visakhapatnam
location: Beach Road, Visakhapatnam — oceanfront boutique hotel with a private beach
why_special: An Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels property — 66 individually furnished rooms, a private beach, rooftop terrace and outdoor pool right on Beach Road. The boutique-scale alternative to the big convention hotels, long a Vizag landmark for its beach bar and nightclub.

name: Welcomhotel by ITC Hotels, Devee Grand Bay
location: Daspalla Hills, Visakhapatnam — hilltop, 100 m from the sea
why_special: An ITC Welcomhotel built around an atrium on a hilltop above Beach Road, with panoramic Bay of Bengal views — 104 rooms, recently renovated, walkable to RK Beach. The pick for ITC-group service and quiet hilltop calm over seafront bustle.

name: Radisson Blu Resort Visakhapatnam
location: Rushikonda Beach Road, Visakhapatnam — beachfront resort at Rushikonda, 21 km from the airport
why_special: Vizag's standout beach resort — 99 rooms on the Rushikonda beachfront with an infinity pool, private beach access and a spa, ranked the city's #1 hotel on Tripadvisor. The pick for a genuine resort stay away from the city centre.

name: Haritha Valley Resort, Araku (APTDC)
location: Araku Valley, Visakhapatnam district — about 700 m from Araku town centre
why_special: The Andhra Pradesh state-tourism resort in Araku — AC cottages, a restaurant serving simple Andhra meals and a pool, within walking distance of the town and tribal museum. The reliable government-run anchor in a hill valley with limited tier-1 stock.

name: Haritha Jungle Bells, Tyda (APTDC)
location: Tyda, Visakhapatnam–Araku Ghat Road — about 40 km from Araku town, at ~2,000 ft
why_special: An APTDC eco-tourism camp on the ghat road to Araku — around 18 wood-and-bamboo cottages set in forest, with guided dawn birdwatching, jungle treks, rock-climbing and twice-weekly campfires. The pick for travellers who want forest immersion on the Vizag–Araku route rather than a town hotel.

name: Ushodaya Resorts, Araku
location: Near Padmapuram Gardens, Araku Valley, Visakhapatnam district
why_special: A 50-room private resort near Padmapuram Gardens in Araku — well-furnished cottages, deluxe rooms and suites with a garden, terrace and restaurant. A verified alternative to the APTDC Haritha for travellers who want more room categories.

name: Ananthagiri Eco Nature Camp (APFDC)
location: Ananthagiri, Visakhapatnam district — about 8 km from Borra Caves
why_special: The Andhra Pradesh Forest Development Corporation eco-camp at Ananthagiri — AC cottage huts with attached washrooms and a 5-bed non-AC dormitory, set in the coffee-plantation hills closest to Borra Caves. The verified forest-run base for visiting the caves.

name: Haritha Hill Resort, Ananthagiri (APTDC)
location: Ananthagiri, Visakhapatnam district — hill resort about 8 km from Borra Caves on the Araku route
why_special: An APTDC Haritha hill resort with independent cottages and hill views at Ananthagiri, the coffee-hill station nearest to Borra Caves. The state-tourism anchor for an overnight near the caves without driving on to Araku.

name: Gandikota Haritha Hotel (APTDC)
location: Gandikota village, Kadapa district — about 1.2 km from the fort and canyon rim
why_special: The only verified accommodation at the Grand Canyon of India — an APTDC Haritha hotel with two-bed AC rooms and an 8-bed dormitory, a short walk from Gandikota Fort and the Pennar gorge. Essential because Gandikota is otherwise a tiny village with no private hotel stock.

name: Haritha Hill Resort, Horsley Hills (APTDC)
location: Horsley Hills, Madanapalle taluk, Chittoor district — at the hill station summit
why_special: The state-tourism resort that effectively is Horsley Hills' accommodation — cottages and the heritage Governor's Bungalow spread across the hilltop, with a restaurant, pool and conference hall. Horsley Hills is a small, protected hill station, so this Haritha is the practical base for any visit.

name: Sterling Palavelli Godavari
location: Yalamanchili, near Dindi, on the Godavari backwaters — Konaseema delta region
why_special: A 13-acre coconut-plantation resort on the Godavari in the Konaseema backwater belt — themed Zamindari and 'Manduva Logili' rooms, an infinity pool and an island dining experience, with private houseboat and rowboat cruises through palm-fringed channels. The standout immersive stay for the delta.

name: Haritha Coconut Country Resort, Dindi (APTDC)
location: Dindi village, Malikipuram, East Godavari — on the banks of the Godavari in Konaseema
why_special: The Andhra Pradesh state-tourism resort on the Godavari at Dindi — a well-managed riverside property with a restaurant, bar, pool and houseboat hire (up to a full day). The dependable government-run anchor for the Konaseema backwaters.

name: RVR Sarovar Portico, Dindi
location: Dindi village, Malikipuram Mandal, East Godavari — riverside resort on the Godavari
why_special: A Sarovar-group riverside resort on the Godavari at Dindi — a Club Mahindra associate property with backwater views, pool and boating, set in the same Konaseema delta belt. A reliable branded mid-to-upper option alongside the Sterling and APTDC resorts.

name: Vanavihari Eco-Tourism Resort
location: Maredumilli, East Godavari district — community-based eco-tourism camp in the Eastern Ghats forest
why_special: A community-based eco-tourism resort run by the Andhra Pradesh Forest Department through the CBET programme — hilltop guest house, Bison Cottages, wooden cottages and pre-fab cottages set in semi-evergreen forest near the village. Income supports local tribal communities; the authoritative way to stay in Maredumilli.

name: Jungle Star Eco Camp, Valamuru
location: Valamuru, Maredumilli range, East Godavari district — on the Valamuru stream in the forest
why_special: An Andhra Pradesh Forest Department community eco-camp run by the local Konda Reddy tribe — tents, cottages and treehouses on an elevated forest spur ringed on three sides by the Valamuru stream, overlooking Vali-Sugriva Konda. The immersive deep-forest option in Maredumilli.

name: Haritha Vijay Vihar, Nagarjuna Sagar (APTDC)
location: Vijayapuri South, Nagarjuna Sagar — overlooking the dam and reservoir
why_special: The Andhra Pradesh state-tourism resort at Nagarjuna Sagar — two-bed AC and non-AC rooms with views over the dam and reservoir, close to the boating point and the launch for Nagarjunakonda island. The standard government-run base for the dam and Buddhist island museum.

name: Haritha Hotel Srisailam (APTDC)
location: Srisailam, Nandyal district — about 400 m from the Bhramaramba Mallikarjuna Swamy temple
why_special: The state-tourism hotel a four-minute walk from the Mallikarjuna jyotirlinga temple — AC and non-AC rooms with a restaurant, the most convenient verified base for pilgrims. A practical anchor in a hill pilgrimage town where private stock is thin.

name: Ganga Sadan (Srisailam Devasthanam)
location: Central Srisailam — walkable from the bus stand and the Mallikarjuna temple
why_special: The Srisaila Devasthanam's main pilgrim accommodation block — spacious, clean rooms with 24-hour hot water in the Ganga-Gowri complex, plus the central reception office. Free trust meals and temple transport make this the authentic devasthanam stay; book on the official Srisaila Devasthanam site.

name: Hotel Srisaila's Nest
location: Sunnipenta, near the APSRTC bus stand, Srisailam — about 1.2 km from the bus stand
why_special: A clean private 3-star at Sunnipenta on the Hyderabad highway approach to Srisailam — two-bed AC rooms, an in-house restaurant and parking. The verified private alternative for travellers who want a hotel rather than a devasthanam choultry.

name: Haritha Lambasingi (APTDC)
location: Lambasingi, Chintapalle mandal, Alluri Sitharama Raju district — in the hill hamlet
why_special: The Andhra Pradesh state-tourism property in Lambasingi itself — elevated blue-and-white cottages with basic rooms and a dorm, the verified government anchor in a tiny hamlet famous for near-freezing December dawns. Book well ahead for the cold-season window.

name: Dhimsa Resort, Lambasingi
location: Lambasingi hill area, Chintapalle mandal, Alluri Sitharama Raju district
why_special: A centrally located private resort in Lambasingi — 18 rooms across Deluxe AC, non-AC and AC wooden cottages, with a multi-cuisine restaurant, picnic lawn, trekking and birdwatching, and evening Dhimsa tribal dance. A verified mid-range alternative to the APTDC property in the December rush.

name: TTD Accommodation, Tirumala (Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams)
location: Tirumala Hills — guest houses and cottages across the hilltop temple town
why_special: The official Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams accommodation on the hill — guest houses, cottages and dormitories (Sri Padmavathi Guest House, Varahaswami, HUDC and others) within reach of the Sri Venkateswara temple. Allotments run 24 hours; book on the official TTD portal 90 days ahead.

name: Taj Tirupati
location: Near Ramanuja Circle, Renigunta Road, Tirupati — about 1 km from the city centre
why_special: Tirupati's only 5-star — 106 rooms, a rooftop pool, Jiva Spa and a fitness centre, on Renigunta Road close to the city. The pick for pilgrims and visitors who want full-service luxury at the foot of the Tirumala hills.

name: Marasa Sarovar Premiere, Tirupati
location: Karakambadi Road, Tirupati — at the foothills of the Tirumala Hills
why_special: A 121-room themed 5-star inspired by the ten avataras of Vishnu — spa, pool, fitness centre and banquet halls, about 5 km from Tirupati railway station. A polished Sarovar-group base for the temple visit with a strong Vaishnava design theme.

name: Fortune Select Grand Ridge, Tirupati
location: Beside Shilparamam, Airport Bypass / Tiruchanoor Road, Tirupati
why_special: A member of the ITC Hotels group in a quiet park-like setting beside the Shilparamam crafts village — non-smoking rooms, an outdoor pool, spa and two restaurants, about 1.2 km from the railway and bus stations. A reliable premium option close to the temple-town hubs.

name: Manjeera Sarovar Premiere, Rajahmundry
location: Arts College Road, Rajahmundry — central, near education and commerce hubs
why_special: Rajahmundry's flagship 5-star — a Sarovar-group hotel built on land leased from APTDC, with multiple room categories, the Flavours multi-cuisine restaurant, the Chill Lounge Bar and the largest convention space in the city (about 35,000 sq ft). The pick for full-service luxury in the Godavari city.

name: Radisson Blu Hotel Rajahmundry
location: Rajahmundry–Kovvur Road, Rajahmundry — on the edge of the Godavari river
why_special: A riverside Radisson Blu on the Godavari — rooms and suites with balconies overlooking the river, a spa and full hotel amenities. The pick for a Godavari-front room with branded service in Rajahmundry.

name: Haritha Hotel Amaravati (APTDC)
location: Amaravati village, Guntur district — about 31 km from Guntur, near the Amareswara temple
why_special: The APTDC Haritha hotel in the temple village of Amaravati — AC rooms with a restaurant and kitchen, the verified state-tourism base for the Amareswara Shiva temple and the Amaravati Buddhist stupa. Practical because Amaravati village itself has little private hotel stock.

name: Lemon Tree Premier, Tirupati
location: Tiruchanoor Renigunta High Road, Tiruchanur, Tirupati
why_special: A 111-room Lemon Tree Premier on Tiruchanoor Road near the Padmavathi Ammavari temple — Citrus Café, a pool bar, spa and fitness centre, with easy access to the city centre and Renigunta railway station. A dependable mid-to-upper option for the temple visit.
